_comment: One-shot forced tick — read by run-tick.ts `auto` on the NAS (which git-pulls main each tick). Fires ONCE inside [notBeforeUtc, expiresUtc) at the next IDLE hour (a scheduled tick wins its own hour); the done-stamp lives in the container's data/.tmp. To arm a new one: change `key` + the window + mode, commit. An expired file is inert — safe to leave in the repo. 2026-08-27 (eia-live): EIA_API_KEY was merged into R2 site-data/runner.env; after the tape-runner container is restarted (so tape-entrypoint sources the refreshed .alert-env), this forced FULL runs refresh-energy WITH the key and back-fills the EIA inventory/production/demand rows, then data-to-r2 ships them. Backstop is the 23:00 UTC scheduled FULL.
